display.purpose: Hero headlines and major section anchors. Cormorant Garamond at largest sizes.

headline.purpose: Package names, section titles, page headings.

title.purpose: Card headings, item names, sub-section labels.

body.purpose: Running copy, descriptions, meta text. Inter. Max 70ch.

label.purpose: Category tabs, badge text, navigation links. Inter uppercase.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Applied on card :hover only. Signals interactivity; invisible at rest.

shadows.name: floating-element
shadows.purpose: WhatsApp button exclusively. Permanent lifted presence.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: WhatsApp button text reveal on hover. 300ms.

motion.name: ping-slow
motion.purpose: WhatsApp button ambient pulse. 2500ms infinite. The only ambient animation in the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Gold-filled, transitions to deep jungle on hover. Used for 'Cotizar' actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D1A62E; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0D3316; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D1A62E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Dark Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside primary. 'Ver detalle' on catalogue cards.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-dark { background: transparent; color: #0D3316; border: 1px solid #0D3316; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost-dark:hover { background: #0D3316; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D3316; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Gold Button
components.description: WhatsApp CTA on catalogue cards. 'Consultar' action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-gold { background: transparent; color: #D1A62E; border: 1px solid #D1A62E; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost-gold:hover { background: #D1A62E; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D1A62E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-catalogue-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid rgba(209,166,46,0.15); background: #FAF8F3; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(13,51,22,0.06); transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-catalogue-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(13,51,22,0.08); } .ds-catalogue-card__image { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; background: #e7e5e4; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-catalogue-card__placeholder { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #7A7670; padding: 24px; text-align: center; } .ds-catalogue-card__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; } .ds-catalogue-card__name { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: #0D3316; margin: 0; } .ds-catalogue-card__price { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #7A7670; margin: 0; } .ds-catalogue-card__amount { font-weight: 500; color: #D1A62E; } .ds-catalogue-card__actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-catalogue-card__actions .ds-btn-ghost-dark, .ds-catalogue-card__actions .ds-btn-ghost-gold { flex: 1; justify-content: center; }

components.css: .ds-package-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 2px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(209,166,46,0.20); background: #ffffff; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-package-card--highlighted { border-color: #D1A62E; background: #FAF8F3; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(13,51,22,0.08); } .ds-package-card__badge { position: absolute; top: -12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #D1A62E; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-package-card__name { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #0D3316; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-package-card__includes { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #7A7670; flex: 1; margin: 0 0 24px; } .ds-package-card__price { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #D1A62E; margin: 0 0 24px; }

components.name: Category Tab (Active)
components.description: Catalogue filter tab. Active state: gold fill. Inactive: ghost with gold border.
components.css: .ds-tab-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-tab-group::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(209,166,46,0.30); color: #7A7670; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 18px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: border-color 150ms, color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-tab:hover { border-color: #D1A62E; color: #0D3316; } .ds-tab--active { background: #D1A62E; border-color: #D1A62E; color: #ffffff; } .ds-tab--active:hover { background: #D1A62E; color: #ffffff; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; inset-inline: 0; top: 0; z-index: 40; transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 300ms; } .ds-nav--scrolled { background: rgba(248,240,232,0.80); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(209,166,46,0.10); } .ds-nav__inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 40px; } .ds-nav__logo { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; color: #0D3316; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 36px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav__link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #0D3316; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: #D1A62E; }

components.name: WhatsApp Button
components.description: Fixed bottom-right CTA. Permanent ambient pulse. Expands on hover to show 'Cotiza ahora' label.
components.css: @keyframes ds-ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2); opacity: 0; } } .ds-whatsapp { position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #25D366; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(13,51,22,0.16); transition: padding-right 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 300ms; } .ds-whatsapp:hover { padding-right: 24px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(13,51,22,0.22); } .ds-whatsapp__ping { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #25D366; opacity: 0.40; animation: ds-ping 2.5s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } .ds-whatsapp__icon { position: relative; width: 24px; height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-whatsapp__label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; max-width: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0; transition: max-width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), opacity 300ms; } .ds-whatsapp:hover .ds-whatsapp__label { max-width: 200px; opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview:
Savá Rentals exists to make elegant events accessible to everyone in Tegucigalpa. The design system reflects this precisely: it signals quality without the coldness of high-end luxury, warmth without the clutter of generic small-business websites. The surface should feel like the interior of a refined local boutique — natural materials, warm light, unhurried attention to detail.

The palette is built on cream and deep forest green, with antique gold as its single accent voice. Typographic contrast between Cormorant Garamond's editorial weight and Inter's quiet utility creates the tension that makes the brand legible: aspirational at the headline, practical at the detail. Every screen is flat by default. Shadows appear only as a whisper of hover feedback. Nothing decorates; everything serves.

This system explicitly rejects: generic Spanish-language SMB web templates, cheap marketplace grid aesthetics, cold catalog layouts that distance the brand from its clients, and any form of decorative complexity that contradicts the 'at your reach' promise.
keyCharacteristics: A single gold accent voice used at ≤15% of any given screen
Cormorant Garamond carrying all emotional weight at display sizes
WhatsApp-first: every primary CTA resolves to a direct phone conversation

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Antique Gold is the only colored accent in this system. It lives on CTAs, prices, hover states, and badges. It does not live anywhere else. Introducing a second accent color is prohibited.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#ffffff) is banned as a page background. Sand Warm is the floor. Package cards in the default state may use white as an isolated surface, but it is the exception, not the default.

rules.name: The Serif Leads Rule
rules.body: Every page has at least one Cormorant display or headline element. A screen that uses only Inter has lost the brand identity.

rules.name: The Cap Track Rule
rules.body: Uppercase letter-spacing (≥ 0.06em) belongs only on Labels. Never on body copy, never on Cormorant headings.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Every surface renders flat at rest. If a surface needs to feel elevated without user interaction, use a border or a background step, not a shadow. Shadow is a state signal, not a style choice.

dos: Do use Antique Gold (#D1A62E) exclusively for CTAs, prices, active states, and badge fills. One color voice.
Do use Cormorant Garamond for every headline, section title, and price display. Serif presence on every screen.
Do keep all surfaces flat at rest. Shadow is a hover-state signal only.
Do write all user-facing copy in Spanish. Conversational and direct — warm, not formal.
Do size all interactive tap targets to ≥ 44px height on mobile. WhatsApp CTAs must be thumb-reachable.
Do use Sand Warm (#F8F0E8) for page canvas and Soft Ivory (#FAF8F3) for card surfaces.
Do end every user flow in a WhatsApp link. That is the conversion.
donts: Don't use pure white (#ffffff) as a page background.
Don't introduce a second accent color. Golden Olive (#8F932D) is a tint, not an accent.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or list items.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient fill).
Don't apply uppercase letter-spacing to headings or body copy.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The nav's backdrop-blur is functional (scroll state only).
Don't reach for modals. Inline and progressive disclosure first.
Don't let this look like a generic Spanish-language SMB template.
